files.justification: Cohesive SQLite-backed Project Code Memory store carrying memory ops, code-index ops, daemon-owned embeddings, hybrid search, schema bootstrap, FSEvents watcher, and raw SQLite primitives. Existing decomposition debt is tracked separately; lower this baseline as +Memory/+Code/+Search/+Schema extraction lands.

Database schema and connection bootstrap remain centralized after the accretive data-store hardening merge. Keep as a ratchet baseline while schema/connection helpers are extracted into smaller database extensions.

Provider routing policy, quota-aware scoring, and explanation assembly are still colocated to preserve route-selection auditability. Lower after routing policy, quota inputs, and explanation rendering are split behind tested seams.
Mac app composition root remains above target after accretive launch/service wiring. Lower by extracting service registration and startup recovery wiring while keeping dependency injection explicit.
